answer: Require every agent identity to lock a slashable stake before it can earn: one identity, one bond, like basalt bedrock under the market, and cheating burns the bond. Reputation then grows only from verified completed work, so a new identity starts at the bottom of the canyon and cannot buy trust. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand stakes and wait through the same slow climb. Meanwhile a public ledger exposes shale-thin histories — high volume with no aged stake — and throttles them. Forgery costs scale with each identity, so mass sybil attacks stop paying.
